ratings.note: Client-side only — a lightweight star UI stored in the visitor's own browser. Aggregate signal is the repo's GitHub stars; no backend collects individual ratings.

seeding.note: AI-conversation seeding. Prompts are composed client-side and copied; the visitor pastes them into their own AI session. No server, no shared key.

byok.note: Bring your own key. Stored only in the visitor's browser (localStorage). Never transmitted to any server we run; used directly from the browser to the provider the visitor chose.

tts.note: Uses the browser's built-in SpeechSynthesis. No network, no key.

talking_artifacts.note: Every figure may declare an explanation, TTS text, a seed hook, and a dimensional descriptor. 3d/hyper figures declare what they are and where they are used; renderers are left as hooks.

learning.note: Select any passage to see linked courses if they exist, or raise a course request as a GitHub issue on the configured learning repo.

participation.fork_note: Visitors can fork their own copy of this book — and the wider workspace (mez, etc.) — from the repo.

litigation_sim.note: Per the contract (C34), a litigation-simulation hook is available from every context. Disabled by default here and wired as a stub; the entry point exists in every reader chrome and points at the configured repo.
